title: Jingle Bells
description: The most famous sleigh-ride song in the world, written by James Lord Pierpont in 1857. The chorus uses just five right-hand notes, making it a perfect first holiday piece.

arrangements.label: Beginner
arrangements.notes: The complete chorus with the right hand fixed in G position and a simple root-then-chord left hand in half notes.
teachingPoints: RH never leaves G position: 1 on G4, 3 on B4, 4 on C5, 5 on D5
Bar 3 and 11 have the dotted-quarter/eighth rhythm on 'all the': count '3-and-4' aloud
LH alternates a bass note and a two-note chord every two beats; keep it steady like sleigh bells
Bars 7-8 change to D and D7: feel the F sharp under the melody before you play
